featured_reviews.name: mrinmoy roy
featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently worked with Exemplar Dot Space for a complete interior home design project in Mulund, and the entire experience was nothing short of exceptional. Right from the initial consultation to the final handover, their professionalism, planning, and attention to detail stood out.
The project was managed efficiently with timely updates and a strong focus on deadlines. Everything was completed within the promised schedule without any last-minute delays. Their time management and structured approach made the entire process smooth and stress-free.They also handled the budget with great transparency. Every cost was clearly explained in advance, and even with minor adjustments, they stayed well within the financial plan. It was refreshing to work with a team that respects both time and money without compromising on quality.A big highlight of the project was the creative input from Ajay the lead designer. His ideas brought a fresh, modern yet practical feel to our home. He carefully understood our lifestyle and preferences and turned them into a beautiful, functional design that feels truly personalized.

The team at Exemplar Dot Space worked with great coordination and professionalism. From the site team to the project managers, everyone was responsive, skilled, and committed. The quality of work—from materials to finishing—was excellent, and the attention to small details really made a difference
Client support was consistent and reliable throughout the journey. We were regularly updated, all queries were addressed quickly, and we always felt supported. Overall, Exemplar Dot Space delivered exactly what they promised a beautiful home, delivered on time, within budget, and designed with heart. Highly recommended for anyone looking to transform their space with a dependable and creative interior team.

featured_reviews.name: Yash Pawar
featured_reviews.review_text: I am absolutely delighted with the work done by Exemplar Dot Space on our home. They delivered great quality, demonstrating impeccable coordination and creativity. From the sleek minimal design we envisioned, right through to the final execution, they designed our home exactly as we imagined. I was thoroughly impressed by their attention to detail and professionalism—Exemplar Dot Space truly exceeded our expectations.

featured_reviews.name: Namrata Sawant
featured_reviews.review_text: We are very happy with the work done by Exemplar Dot Space. The team was professional, the execution was smooth, and every detail was handled with care. Their commitment to quality and timely delivery truly impressed us. A genuine and reliable team to work with!

featured_reviews.name: Shanaya Talati
featured_reviews.review_text:
Extremely Disappointed and Emotionally Drained – Avoid Exemplar Dot at All Costs

Our experience with Exemplar Dot has been nothing short of a nightmare. What started as a hopeful project turned into nearly 9 months of emotional, mental, and physical distress for our entire family. After paying a significant amount of money upfront, we were left high and dry – with almost no products delivered, no workmen sent, and no real communication or accountability from their team.

One of the three directors was the in-charge for our project, Istekhar. While he showed no respect or consideration for any issues raised, ironically, none of the other two directors even bothered catering to the escalating issues that were brought to their attention. Operating like a lala company, they don't care about anyone or anything!!

They operate in a completely disorganized and unprofessional manner. Deadlines are endlessly postponed, promises are broken without explanation, and when products do arrive, they are often incorrect, of extremely poor quality, usually damaged and entirely unacceptable. We were appalled by how shoddy and substandard the delivered items were — absolutely nowhere near what was promised. The modular furniture which was ordered to provide a neat finish and apparently quick delivery with quick installation was only a hollow display of work, when infact the modular is of the worst quality and the modular team doesn't work to produce the items based on drawings and dimensions. Everything is simply rectifiable for the team in a non-existent future instead of acting upon it in the present.

Despite repeated follow-ups, our home remains incomplete. No workers arrive to finish the job, and the site has been abandoned for weeks. What’s worse is the unethical way they retain clients’ money without delivering anything of value. It has caused immense stress to us mentally, emotionally, and physically – watching our hard-earned money disappear with no results and no clarity.

Please, do yourself a favor and stay away from Exemplar Dot. Their lack of ethics, professionalism, and empathy has made this experience deeply scarring for our family.

featured_reviews.name: Darren Talati
featured_reviews.review_text:
Before you waste your time and money, read this. Five minutes now could save you from months of regret.

If negative stars were an option, Exemplar Dot Space would get them all. Our experience with this firm has been nothing short of a scam wrapped in fake promises and zero accountability.

False Promises, Fake Deadlines & Endless Excuses:
Our project started in July with a promised completion by Diwali. Then came December, Christmas, mid-Jan, mid-Feb, and now it’s March—with only 70% of the house completed. Every single deadline was given by them, yet missed with excuse after excuse—workers unavailable, vendor delays, production issues, "aa jayega." The only thing that ever "came" was another round of lies and stalling tactics.

Modular Disaster – A Joke of Execution:
We were assured that modular furniture would be the best finish with fast execution. What a joke. Nine months later, our modular is still incomplete. We took 8 separate deliveries, yet the shutters arrived in the wrong sizes—we needed 8ft shutters, they sent 7ft ones. How do you even mess up something this basic? Every single plank and shutter is damaged and their response? "Sab replace ho jayega." Sure, just like everything else they promised.

Istekhar, the so-called person in charge (also one of the directors), would ignore messages for days, only to show up virtually at 11-11:30pm. Excuse me? I’m a paying client, not your friend. Treat us with some professionalism.

Financial Exploitation – Holding Work Hostage for Money:
Despite never delaying a single payment, we were constantly told vendors weren’t paid. Then in end-February, during a meeting, Istekhar straight-up said:
"Ma’am, if you don’t give payment, work will slow down, nothing else."
Excuse me? We had already overpaid for unfinished work, yet this was the attitude we got. This is when we sensed something sus and put our foot down. This wasn’t a project anymore—we were being used like an ATM machine.

Internal Chaos & Unprofessionalism:
So apparently they subcontracted vendors who weren’t paid, so they stopped working. Then a new team showed up, leading to a literal argument between the old and new teams ON OUR SITE. My house is not a war zone, but these people turned it into one.

The "project manager" was totally clueless, making us run to buy materials as basic as glue for LED strips. Meanwhile, the people who pitched the project—Devi and Pratik—vanished after the first meeting. Istekhar showed up only when payments were due—convenient, isn’t it?

Final Straw – The Last Big Lie:
When we drove them out in frustration, Istekhar suddenly claimed that all the modular furniture was ready for delivery THAT day. Oh really? Then we asked for the delivery the next day. Nothing came. No calls. No response. What a shameless, efficient, emotionless lie. They knew we had already paid, so why bother delivering?

Final Words – Your Dream Home Deserves Better:
A dream home is not just a structure—it’s a lifetime of planning, savings, and emotions. It’s supposed to be a place of joy, not a battlefield of broken promises, delays, and financial stress. Exemplar Dot Space robbed us of that experience, turning what should have been a beautiful journey into nine months of frustration and regret.

Oh, and I’m sure if the team reads this, they’ll have a brand-new excuse ready—probably something like “The client didn’t let us complete the project.” Right, because clearly, I should’ve just handed you a five-year lease on my unfinished house for a 1000 sq. ft. job with no bathrooms or civil work. Maybe I should’ve also thrown in a spa day and a vacation so you could really take your time? Hilarious.
0/10 recommendation score.

featured_reviews.review_text: I have been using the BloomDesk Coworking space for 5 months for my psychotherapy sessions. Ms. Hetal has been helpful too in addressing any queries regarding renting the space. However, two drawbacks should be addressed: 1. The cabins are not soundproof, which disturbs the flow of meditation (I conduct meditative activities when necessary for my clients). 2. The lift is not accessible for those using the commercial side of the building, which can be inconvenient for those who have problems climbing the stairs. If these drawbacks are not applicable for you, I will certainly recommend it!
